name: Wang and Buzsaki 1996 hippocampal interneuron
citation: Wang X-J, Buzsaki G (1996). Gamma oscillation by synaptic inhibition in a hippocampal interneuronal network model. J Neurosci 16(20):6402-6413. doi:10.1523/jneurosci.16-20-06402.1996
expected_behavior: Single compartment; instantaneous Na activation (custom gate type); fast tonic non-adapting firing.
inclusion_reason: EXCLUDED from the primary study (D-051): its own cell file fails NeuroML v2.3.1 validation - jnml: "cvc-complex-type.3.2.2: Attribute 'type' is not allowed to appear in element 'gateHHrates'" (WangBuzsaki.cell.nml line 10, type=gateHHratesInstantaneous; the network file passes and libNeuroML strict passes). Including it would need a model-specific schema exception or a manual repair that changes the representation of the instantaneous sodium activation gate; it is not repaired. Provenance: OpenSourceBrain/WangBuzsaki1996 @ c532284492c3e421a7f8e88b3090af8ffee8cf6a, hash-verified snapshot; licence MIT (NeuroML2 directory), verified at that commit. Execution is fine (shipped harness runs, 10 spikes; rheobase 0.00017 nA). Potential exploratory use: a prespecified sensitivity analysis with the baseline-error exception, reported separately and never pooled. Packet: docs/WANG_BUZSAKI_DECISION_PACKET.md
